title: Match landing page reference design
summary: Reworked the site landing page to closely match the provided dark reference design. The page now uses the reference's dark shell, hero copy, compact command/action area, animated right-side EVE flow, comparison panel, process steps, local-first Git-native diagram, and final CTA section.
userVisibleChange: The landing page now matches the supplied reference design much more closely, including the dark hero, animated plan/snapshot flow, comparison table, plan-to-review steps, local-first diagram, and final CTA.

risks.title: Exact visual matching depends on browser font rendering
risks.mitigation: Used system UI font stacks and inspected at the same 1024x1536 reference image size to tune line breaks and proportions.

timeline.title: Locked reference-match plan
timeline.summary: Scoped the page rewrite to site/app/page.tsx and site/app/global.css.

timeline.title: Matched reference landing design
timeline.summary: Rebuilt the landing page structure and dark CSS system around the supplied screenshot.

timeline.title: Verified build and browser views
timeline.summary: Ran the production build, desktop/mobile visual checks, reduced-motion check, and console check.

decisions.title: Rebuild the whole landing composition instead of only the hero
decisions.rationale: The reference design includes the comparison panel, step flow, storage diagram, and CTA; matching it required replacing the previous page structure rather than tuning the prior lightweight landing page.

decisions.title: Use CSS-only motion for the hero flow
decisions.rationale: The animation is presentational and can stay server-rendered with transform/opacity keyframes, avoiding client-side JavaScript.

decisions.title: Use compact mobile table columns
decisions.rationale: The desktop comparison table would clip on narrow screens, so mobile uses a tighter three-column layout that preserves all content.

decisions.title: Respect reduced motion
decisions.rationale: Looping hero animation is disabled for users who request reduced motion.
